planets.name: HAT-P-22 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-22 with a 3.21-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: HAT-P-22 b was found in 2010 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-22. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2010, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.2122302, pl_radj 1.15, pl_bmassj 2.47
